open: Whether the station-building underpass reaches the island platforms (and has lifts) is unknown; Bane NOR mentions lifts only at the west-end footbridge. Wikipedia says the underpass was replaced by an overpass in the 1990s upgrade, but Bane NOR's current text and the artwork describe a working underpass at the station building. [Lift follow-up 2026-10-30: Not settled. OSM's underpass at the station building reaches only the track 6 side and has no lifts. No owner plan or photo shows whether it continues to the islands. Missing: a Bane NOR station plan or a dated photo of the underpass.]
Signposted names for the levels, the underpass and the footbridge not found; no heights in any source.
Narvesen hours missing (not in OSM; narvesen.no unreadable). Espresso House and Peppes hours are from OSM only; Glorioso's published hours are labelled July 2026.
Rema 1000 is mentioned by Bane NOR as a landmark ('Glasshuset' between Rema 1000 and the parking garage) but is not in the OSM extract and rema.no's page did not render, so it is not listed.

Nearby but outside the station building per OSM, not listed as station shops: Vitusapotek Asker (n2501000580, OSM Mo-Fr 09:00-18:00, Sa 10:00-15:00), Kårner café (w87862755), Egon (n7964121643), Sparebanken Øst and Danske Bank branches, Vasen shop.
Toilets: no source mentions toilets at Asker station. ATM position unknown (Bane NOR English page lists one; none in the OSM extract).
Main station-building entrances are not in OSM (only n8871541081, unattributed).

answers.question: (no open-question list for Norway; levels, ways to the platforms, entrances and shops requested)
answers.answer: Six tracks: side platform 1 (town side, bus and taxi), island platforms 2/3 and 4/5, side platform 6. Two crossings: an underpass at the station building (ticket machine inside; OSM w306981125 reaching platforms 1 and 6, with a ramp and stairs to platform 6 via w1120605495) and a footbridge at the west end with lifts (Bane NOR; OSM has 3 lifts, w67300743). Shops in the station building: Narvesen, Espresso House, Glorioso; Peppes Pizza next door.
answers._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-a-/asker/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_no/NO-ASR.json), read 2026-10-30; Glorioso https://glorioso.no/, read 2026-10-30

answers.question: Island platforms 2/3 and 4/5 are not in the OSM extract, so how they are reached (which stairs/lifts from the footbridge or underpass) is not established. OSM has only 3 lifts at the footbridge, while a lift per platform would need 4; Bane NOR only says 'heis i tilknytning til overgangsbroen'.
answers.answer: Lifts serve platform 1, platform 2/3, platform 4/5 (The raw OSM extract does contain both island platforms, as relations r7592987 (ref 2;3) and r7592986 (ref 4;5); the earlier facts extract missed relations. Each of the three footbridge lifts (levels 0;1) lies inside one outline: n10128519313 serves platform 1, n10128519312 serves platform 2/3, and n10128519311 serves platform 4/5. Platform 6 (w133645357) has no lift in OSM; the nearest is 16.8 m away. That is consistent with OSM having 3 lifts, not 4. Source is OSM only.)
